name: JS Paint
tagline: Classic MS Paint, on this device. Nothing is uploaded.
description:
Every tool from MS Paint, running as an ordinary app: pencil, brush, eraser, fill, airbrush, text, select, shapes, undo that keeps every branch, zoom with a grid, and Save As PNG, GIF, JPEG or BMP. The picture auto-saves on this computer, inside the app. Close it, open it later, the canvas is where you left it.

An unofficial port of JS Paint by Isaiah Odhner, MIT-licensed. This copy is local. There is no account, no Imgur, no multiplayer session, no speech-to-Google, and no tracker. File > Open and File > Save As stay on the device. Themes included are Classic Light and Classic Dark.

Not in this copy: Load from URL, Upload to Imgur, online sessions, eye tracking, speech recognition, or extra seasonal skins. The drawing tools are.
